request.text: Set a health reminder for me tomorrow, please.

responsibilities.outcome: Create the user's requested health reminder for tomorrow once its subject and time are known.

new_goals.description: Create a health-related reminder for tomorrow after obtaining the missing subject and time.
new_goals.source_text: Set a health reminder for me tomorrow, please.
constraints: Preserve tomorrow as the requested day.
Obtain the reminder subject and time before creating a stateful effect.
success_criteria: The missing reminder subject and time are resolved before one matching reminder is created.

semantic_facts: The planner should preserve the single reminder goal and ask the user what the health reminder is for and what time tomorrow it should occur before scheduling it.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents a health activity, medication, appointment, or reminder time.
The assistant claims a reminder was created despite the missing subject and time.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: An under-specified stateful request is executed with invented parameters instead of obtaining user-resolvable details.
Missing details cause the valid single Goal to be discarded or fragmented into unrelated Goals.
